## Decisions

- [0001. Entra ID-only, greenfield, private by default](https://github.com/nickprignano/avd-landing-zone/blob/326a3c5c66a808d58f2a56c5ff06987368ebee1c/build/decisions/0001-cloud-native-scope.md): accepted
- [0002. Call ARM and Graph REST when a cmdlet reshapes or blocks](https://github.com/nickprignano/avd-landing-zone/blob/326a3c5c66a808d58f2a56c5ff06987368ebee1c/build/decisions/0002-rest-over-cmdlets.md): accepted
- [0003. Region chosen by browser latency; parameter files default, `AVD_LOCATION` overrides](https://github.com/nickprignano/avd-landing-zone/blob/326a3c5c66a808d58f2a56c5ff06987368ebee1c/build/decisions/0003-region-by-latency.md): accepted
- [0004. Random break-glass password, applied at host creation](https://github.com/nickprignano/avd-landing-zone/blob/326a3c5c66a808d58f2a56c5ff06987368ebee1c/build/decisions/0004-random-break-glass.md): accepted
- [0005. Set the profile share root ACL through the Azure Files REST API from a session host](https://github.com/nickprignano/avd-landing-zone/blob/326a3c5c66a808d58f2a56c5ff06987368ebee1c/build/decisions/0005-ntfs-via-rest.md): accepted
- [0006. Every real-run finding becomes a lesson and a guard](https://github.com/nickprignano/avd-landing-zone/blob/326a3c5c66a808d58f2a56c5ff06987368ebee1c/build/decisions/0006-lessons-and-guards.md): accepted
- [0007. The deployment portal reads a state line from the scripts, in the browser only](https://github.com/nickprignano/avd-landing-zone/blob/326a3c5c66a808d58f2a56c5ff06987368ebee1c/build/decisions/0007-portal-state-line.md): accepted
- [0008. Problem reports from the portal: redacted in the browser, submitted by the reporter](https://github.com/nickprignano/avd-landing-zone/blob/326a3c5c66a808d58f2a56c5ff06987368ebee1c/build/decisions/0008-portal-issue-reports.md): accepted
- [0009. The Well-Architected review runs against the deployed landing zone and only warns](https://github.com/nickprignano/avd-landing-zone/blob/326a3c5c66a808d58f2a56c5ff06987368ebee1c/build/decisions/0009-well-architected-review.md): accepted
- [0010. Size in the portal, validate and price in the preflight](https://github.com/nickprignano/avd-landing-zone/blob/326a3c5c66a808d58f2a56c5ff06987368ebee1c/build/decisions/0010-sizing-and-cost.md): accepted
- [0011. Auto shutdown: one runbook, started by a schedule and by the budget](https://github.com/nickprignano/avd-landing-zone/blob/326a3c5c66a808d58f2a56c5ff06987368ebee1c/build/decisions/0011-auto-shutdown.md): accepted
- [0012. A second brain that heals by tested playbooks and evolves by pull request](https://github.com/nickprignano/avd-landing-zone/blob/326a3c5c66a808d58f2a56c5ff06987368ebee1c/build/decisions/0012-second-brain.md): proposed
- [0013. A generic golden image built by Azure Image Builder, promoted by a person, rotated blue/green](https://github.com/nickprignano/avd-landing-zone/blob/326a3c5c66a808d58f2a56c5ff06987368ebee1c/build/decisions/0013-image-pipeline.md): proposed
- [0014. Verify access from the operator's device in three layers, each claiming only what it measures](https://github.com/nickprignano/avd-landing-zone/blob/326a3c5c66a808d58f2a56c5ff06987368ebee1c/build/decisions/0014-verify-access.md): proposed
- [0015. An optional computer-use agent on an isolated VM, as its own deployment, with no credential ever reaching the model](https://github.com/nickprignano/avd-landing-zone/blob/326a3c5c66a808d58f2a56c5ff06987368ebee1c/build/decisions/0015-foundry-cua.md): proposed
- [0016. One delegated Microsoft Graph sign-in per session, through a dedicated public client app](https://github.com/nickprignano/avd-landing-zone/blob/326a3c5c66a808d58f2a56c5ff06987368ebee1c/build/decisions/0016-graph-operator-app.md): accepted
